mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS watchlistId, w.user_id AS userId, w.asset_type AS assetType, w.asset_code AS assetCode, w.remark, w.sort_order AS sortOrder, s.stock_name AS stockName, s.industry, s.market, d.close_price AS price, d.change_percent AS changePct, d.high_price AS highPrice, d.low_price AS lowPrice, d.volume, d.amount FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN stock s ON w.asset_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN stock_daily d ON w.asset_code = d.stock_code AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily) WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.asset_type = 0 ORDER BY w.sort_order ASC, w.created_at ASC

SELECT w.id AS watchlistId, w.user_id AS userId, w.asset_type AS assetType, w.asset_code AS assetCode, w.remark, w.sort_order AS sortOrder, f.fund_name AS fundName, f.fund_type AS fundType, f.company, fn.nav, fn.accumulated_nav AS accumulatedNav, fn.nav_date AS navDate, fn.daily_return AS dailyReturn FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN fund f ON w.asset_code = f.fund_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fn1.* FROM fund_nav fn1 WHERE fn1.nav_date = ( SELECT MAX(fn2.nav_date) FROM fund_nav fn2 WHERE fn2.fund_code = fn1.fund_code ) ) fn ON w.asset_code = fn.fund_code WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.asset_type = 1 ORDER BY w.sort_order ASC, w.created_at ASC

SELECT w.id AS watchlistId, w.user_id AS userId, w.asset_type AS assetType, w.asset_code AS assetCode, w.remark, w.sort_order AS sortOrder, CASE w.asset_type WHEN 0 THEN s.stock_name WHEN 1 THEN f.fund_name END AS assetName, CASE w.asset_type WHEN 0 THEN s.industry ELSE f.fund_type END AS assetCategory, CASE w.asset_type WHEN 0 THEN CAST(d.close_price AS CHAR) ELSE CAST(fn.nav AS CHAR) END AS currentPrice FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN stock s ON w.asset_type = 0 AND w.asset_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN fund f ON w.asset_type = 1 AND w.asset_code = f.fund_code LEFT JOIN stock_daily d ON w.asset_type = 0 AND w.asset_code = d.stock_code AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fn1.* FROM fund_nav fn1 WHERE fn1.nav_date = ( SELECT MAX(fn2.nav_date) FROM fund_nav fn2 WHERE fn2.fund_code = fn1.fund_code ) ) fn ON w.asset_type = 1 AND w.asset_code = fn.fund_code WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.asset_type ASC, w.sort_order ASC, w.created_at ASC
